programs.title: Blood in the Water
programs.desc: A young woman, feeling guilty for a crime she committed but never got caught for, ends up being trapped by a sadistic person. They're playing a game of Russian roulette, but with a twist—it involves a great white shark and four other people who've managed to dodge the law too.

programs.title: Showdown in Yesteryear
programs.desc: An aspiring cowboy discovers a peculiar door standing alone in an open field. His curiosity leads him through it and into the lawless frontier of 1860s America, where he must navigate a perilous world of gunslingers and outlaws.

programs.title: Barbarian Queen
programs.desc: A sword-wielding warrior, Amethea, and a few companions embark on a life-or-death mission to liberate her people from the clutches of a brutal monarch who destroyed her village and enslaved her people.

programs.title: Dreamchild
programs.desc: Ian Holm stars as the children's author Lewis Carroll in a touching fantasy-drama set in 1930s New York, featuring amazing special effects creatures from Muppet creator Jim Henson.

programs.title: An Eskimo Tale
programs.desc: Three young Inuits set off in search of a promised land to save their clan from starvation. AKA The Legend of Sarila and AKA Frozen Land

programs.title: Captain Sharky
programs.desc: Pint-sized swashbuckler Captain Sharky thinks he's the most dangerous pirate on the Seven Seas. To prove his bravery, he sets sail with Mikey, a well-behaved boy whose life Sharky has turned upside down, and Bonnie, a trouble-shooting girl who tends to assume command in every situation. This motley crew sails for big adventures as they thwart the plans of The Admiral and Old Bill the Pirate.
